## TimeTable shapes (positional; one output per value column)

CDL.Reals.Sources.TimeTable table=2x2
  in  (0)
  out (1) y1:Real
CDL.Reals.Sources.TimeTable table=3x3
  in  (0)
  out (2) y1:Real y2:Real
CDL.Reals.Sources.TimeTable table=2x4
  in  (0)
  out (3) y1:Real y2:Real y3:Real
CDL.Integers.Sources.TimeTable table=2x2
  in  (0)
  out (1) y1:Integer
CDL.Integers.Sources.TimeTable table=3x3
  in  (0)
  out (2) y1:Integer y2:Integer
CDL.Integers.Sources.TimeTable table=2x4
  in  (0)
  out (3) y1:Integer y2:Integer y3:Integer

  in  (0)
  out (1) y1:Boolean

  in  (0)
  out (2) y1:Boolean y2:Boolean
CDL.Logical.Sources.TimeTable table=2x4
  in  (0)
  out (3) y1:Boolean y2:Boolean y3:Boolean
